name: Silk Wrap Dress
description: Elegant silk wrap dress with a flattering silhouette. Crafted from 100% mulberry silk with a luxurious drape and subtle sheen.
fitNote: Runs true to size; the wrap front adjusts at the waist for a flexible fit.
care: Dry clean recommended. If hand washing, use cold water and a silk-safe detergent; do not wring. Iron on a low/silk setting.
sustainabilityDetail: 100% mulberry silk — a natural, biodegradable fibre.

name: Organic Cotton Blazer
description: Tailored blazer made from certified organic cotton. Features a modern slim fit with peak lapels and functional pocket design.
fitNote: Runs slightly small across the shoulders — size up if you layer underneath or prefer a relaxed fit.
care: Dry clean recommended to preserve the structured shape. Steam to refresh between wears.
sustainabilityDetail: GOTS-certified organic cotton, grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilisers.

name: Cashmere Turtleneck
description: Ultra-soft cashmere turtleneck sweater. Sustainably sourced Mongolian cashmere with a relaxed fit and ribbed detailing.
fitNote: Runs true to size; natural fibres may relax slightly with wear.
care: Hand wash cold with a wool/cashmere detergent, or dry clean. Dry flat; do not wring. Store folded to avoid stretching.
sustainabilityDetail: Sustainably sourced Mongolian cashmere from certified herding cooperatives.

name: Leather Crossbody Bag
description: Minimalist crossbody bag in premium vegetable-tanned leather. Features an adjustable strap, interior card slots, and magnetic closure.
fitNote: Adjustable strap — wear as a crossbody or on the shoulder.
care: Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Condition occasionally with a leather balm. Keep away from prolonged moisture and direct sunlight.

name: Linen Wide-Leg Trousers
description: Relaxed wide-leg trousers in European flax linen. High-waisted with a flowing drape, perfect for warm-weather styling.
fitNote: Runs true to size; linen softens and relaxes with wear.
care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle; line dry. Iron damp on a medium-high setting for a crisp look.
sustainabilityDetail: European flax linen — a natural fibre grown with minimal water, retted without irrigation.

name: Merino Wool Coat
description: Classic double-breasted coat in Italian merino wool. Fully lined with horn buttons and a timeless silhouette that transcends seasons.
fitNote: Runs true to size; already sized to layer over a blazer or knit — no need to size up.
care: Dry clean only. Store on a sturdy hanger; brush gently to remove surface lint.

name: Silk Camisole Top
description: Delicate silk camisole with adjustable straps and a scalloped lace trim. Versatile enough for layering or wearing solo.
fitNote: Runs true to size; the lace trim is delicate — handle with care.
care: Hand wash cold with a silk-safe detergent; do not wring. Iron on a low/silk setting.
sustainabilityDetail: Natural silk with delicate lace — biodegradable fibres.

name: Recycled Denim Jacket
description: Classic denim jacket made from 100% recycled denim fibers. Vintage-inspired wash with contemporary fit and brass hardware.
fitNote: Runs true to size; denim may stretch slightly with wear.
care: Machine wash cold inside out with similar colours; line dry. Iron on medium if needed.
sustainabilityDetail: Made from 100% post-consumer recycled denim, reducing water and raw-material use.

name: Tailored Wool Trousers
description: Sharp tailored trousers in premium wool blend. Featuring a pressed crease, side pockets, and a comfortable mid-rise waist.
fitNote: Runs true to size; mid-rise and fitted through the seat.
care: Dry clean recommended. Steam to refresh; hang to air out between wears.

name: Gold Chain Necklace
description: Minimalist gold-plated chain necklace with a delicate pendant. Hypoallergenic stainless steel base with 18k gold plating.
fitNote: Adjustable chain length.
care: Avoid contact with water, perfume and lotion to preserve the plating. Store in a dry pouch; wipe with a soft cloth.

name: Velvet Evening Gown
description: Showstopping velvet evening gown with a floor-length silhouette. Features a dramatic back slit and off-shoulder neckline.
fitNote: Runs slightly small through the bodice — consider sizing up for an easier fit.
care: Dry clean only. Store hanging to avoid crushing the pile; avoid folding.

name: Cotton Striped Shirt
description: Classic button-down shirt in breathable organic cotton. Features a relaxed fit with Mother of Pearl buttons and a timeless striped pattern.
fitNote: Runs true to size; relaxed through the body.
care: Machine wash cold with similar colours; line dry or tumble dry low. Iron on medium-high.
sustainabilityDetail: GOTS-certified organic cotton with Mother of Pearl buttons and low-impact dyes.

name: Leather Chelsea Boots
description: Handcrafted Chelsea boots in premium calfskin leather. Features elastic side panels, a stacked wooden heel, and a durable rubber sole.
fitNote: Runs true to size; leather gives slightly with wear. Size up for wider feet or thick socks.
care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth; condition the leather regularly. Use shoe trees to hold the shape.

name: Ribbed Knit Midi Skirt
description: Comfortable midi skirt in a soft ribbed knit. Elastic waistband with a figure-flattering fit that transitions effortlessly from day to night.
fitNote: Runs true to size; the elastic waistband gives some flexibility.
care: Hand wash cold or a gentle machine cycle; dry flat. Fold to store.

name: Wool Blend Scarf
description: Generously sized scarf in a luxurious wool-cashmere blend. Finished with hand-rolled edges and a subtle herringbone pattern.
fitNote: Generously sized for versatile wrapping.
care: Dry clean or hand wash cold with a wool detergent; dry flat. Store folded with cedar to deter moths.

name: Tencel Jumpsuit
description: Relaxed-fit jumpsuit crafted from sustainable Tencel lyocell. Features a tied waist, wide legs, and a flattering V-neckline.
fitNote: Runs true to size; the tied waist is forgiving across body types.
care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle; line dry. Iron on a low-medium setting.
sustainabilityDetail: 100% Tencel Lyocell, produced in a closed-loop process from sustainably sourced wood pulp.

name: Canvas Sneakers
description: Minimalist canvas sneakers with a vulcanized rubber sole. Organic cotton upper with a cushioned insole for all-day comfort.
fitNote: Runs true to size; canvas softens with wear.
care: Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap; air dry away from direct heat. Air out the insole between wears.
sustainabilityDetail: Organic cotton canvas upper with a durable vulcanised rubber sole.

name: Satin Pajama Set
description: Luxurious satin pajama set with a relaxed fit. Includes a collared button-up top and matching straight-leg trousers with piping detail.
fitNote: Runs true to size; relaxed for comfortable sleep.
care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle; line dry or tumble dry low. Iron on a low setting if needed.

name: Puffer Vest
description: Lightweight puffer vest with recycled down filling. Water-resistant outer shell with a high collar and two-way zip closure.
material: Recycled Nylon Shell, Recycled Down Fill
fitNote: Runs true to size; roomy enough for layering over a sweater.
care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle with a down-safe detergent; tumble dry low with dryer balls to re-loft the down.
sustainabilityDetail: Recycled nylon shell and recycled down fill, diverting waste from landfill.

name: Woven Straw Hat
description: Hand-woven straw hat with a wide brim and a silk ribbon band. Provides elegant sun protection with a timeless summer aesthetic.
fitNote: Choose by head circumference: S/M 55-57cm, L/XL 58-60cm.
care: Avoid prolonged moisture; store flat or hung to preserve the brim shape. Spot clean only.
sustainabilityDetail: Hand-woven natural straw with a silk ribbon trim — natural, biodegradable materials.

name: Alpaca Cardigan
description: Oversized cardigan in ethically sourced baby alpaca wool. Features dropped shoulders, patch pockets, and coconut shell buttons.
fitNote: Intentionally oversized — size down for a closer fit. Sized S/M and L/XL.
care: Hand wash cold with a wool detergent; dry flat. Fold to store; avoid hanging.
sustainabilityDetail: Ethically sourced baby alpaca wool from certified Andean cooperatives.

name: Pleated Midi Dress
description: Flowing pleated midi dress with a metallic sheen. Features a boat neckline, three-quarter sleeves, and a relaxed A-line silhouette.
fitNote: Runs true to size; the A-line silhouette is forgiving.
care: Dry clean recommended to preserve the pleats; do not iron out the pleating.

name: Suede Ankle Boots
description: Chic ankle boots in buttery-soft suede with a block heel. Inside zip closure and padded insole for lasting comfort throughout the day.
fitNote: Runs true to size; suede gives slightly with wear. Size up for wider feet.
care: Brush suede regularly with a suede brush; treat with a suede protector before first wear. Air dry away from heat.

name: Linen Shirt Dress
description: Effortless shirt dress in softened linen. Belted waist, rolled sleeves, and a knee-length hem for an easy, polished summer look.
fitNote: Runs true to size; the belted waist allows some flexibility.
care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle; line dry. Iron damp on medium-high for a crisp finish.
sustainabilityDetail: 100% European flax linen — naturally grown with minimal water and no irrigation.

name: Pearl Drop Earrings
description: Elegant freshwater pearl drop earrings with a gold-fill hook. Timeless design that adds sophistication to any outfit, day or evening.
fitNote: Lightweight; 14k gold-fill hooks are suitable for sensitive ears.
care: Avoid water, perfume and cosmetics. Wipe pearls with a soft cloth; store separately to avoid scratching.
